method: Assistant visual inspection of all472 retained source reproductions in the Sisley, Pissarro and Cezanne reference/development panels. Work IDs and SHA-256 were joined to acquisitions and all raw hashes verified. EXIF-oriented contact sheets used IDs only, with no original titles/content labels or model scores shown. All352 reference content classes were recorded before joining original title labels. All104 potentially problematic peripheral regions were enlarged in six-image sheets. Only clearly separate external peripheral regions received conservative normalized rectangular boxes; uncertain edges and original support/blank canvas remain intact. This is source-quality screening, not human evaluation, expert art classification, or an independent fidelity validation. Crop boxes are visually chosen approximate enclosing painting rectangles; small residual shadows/corner margins can remain. No source colors were altered. All73 proposed crops were also inspected on four cropped-image contact sheets before finalizing; no obvious painting/signature clipping was observed.
